phase: Phase 5: Embeddable Runtime, i18n, and Shared Package
summary: Phase 5 strategy frozen. Seven product/technical decisions recorded in phase-5-decisions.md: (5.1) embeddable navigation contract via host-injected onNavigate callback, removing window.location.href exits and hardcoded /en/ hrefs from representative games (haunted-library + dragon-rider); (5.2) i18n message source via host-injectable GamesLocaleContext, generateStaticParams returns ['en','th','zh'], useScopedI18n uses existing en.ts tree with explicit key-fallback for th/zh (no next-intl migration); (5.3) shared games runtime module at apps/advantage-games/src/lib/games-runtime/ consolidating one canonical VirtualDPad (memoized), one withBasePath, one calculateClientXP (display preview distinct from server-side calculateGameXP), with re-export shims preserving import paths for unmigrated games; (5.4) representative game scope — haunted-library (harness, already clean) + dragon-rider (navigation-fix sample); (5.5) import-harness proof at apps/advantage-games/src/__tests__/import-harness/haunted-library-import.test.tsx rendering HauntedLibraryGame inside a HostShell mock asserting embeddable navigation (no window.location mutation + onNavigate fires), i18n (locale=th flows to fetch + useCurrentLocale), host progress integration (onComplete payload reaches mocked recordGameCompletion with fire-once duplicate:true on second call), and shared runtime (canonical VirtualDPad + calculateClientXP labeled integer); (5.6) jest gate commands scoped to vocabulary-games filter, no domain/db schema changes so existing Phase 3/4 gates are regression-only; (5.7) eight explicit non-goals (no 24-game migration, no packages/games-runtime workspace extraction, no duplicate-file drop, no next-intl migration, no real th/zh translations, no production import, no packages/domain or packages/db modification, no per-game calculateXP touch). Test strategy section 0.E to be updated with five test groups 5A..5E and anti-pattern defenses. Plan.md Phase 5 strategy task marked [x]. Tier 2 items deferred to successor track / po / infra.
nonblocking_findings: Phase 5 does not migrate the remaining 24 games; only haunted-library (harness) and dragon-rider (navigation-fix sample) migrate. The 10 window.location.href exits in archers-revenge/paladins-twin-soul/enchanted-library/village-guardian/rune-forge-chamber/labyrinth-goblin-king/dungeon-liberator/realm-carver/shadow-gate-dungeon/spellweavers-run remain until the successor track.
Phase 5 does not extract packages/games-runtime workspace package; the canonical module lives at apps/advantage-games/src/lib/games-runtime/. Workspace extraction is the successor-track Tier 2 item.

Phase 5 does not drop the duplicate VirtualDPad/basePath/xp files; they become re-exports of the canonical module so unmigrated games don't break. Dropping the shims is the successor-track Tier 2 item.
Phase 5 does not migrate to next-intl/next-international; the custom client.ts is kept with a host-injectable locale source. Framework migration is deferred:infra.
Phase 5 does not provide real th.ts/zh.ts translation content; it wires the locale source + key-fallback. Translation content is deferred:po (product decision).
Phase 5 does not wire the host production import; it delivers the harness proof only. The haunted-library production pilot in Reading Advantage is the successor track.
Phase 5 does not modify packages/domain/src/games/ (Phase 3 contract) or packages/db/src/schema/analytics.ts (Phase 4 persistence); the contract + persistence layers are frozen.

Phase 5 does not touch the 8 per-game calculateXP functions (hauntedLibrary.ts, realmCarver.ts, paladinsTwinSoul.ts, griffinSkyJoust.ts, gryphonPatrol.ts, griffinRidersEscape.ts, shadowGateDungeon.ts, runeForgeChamber.ts); they are correctly game-specific state->XP mappers, not runtime primitives.
